title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Ays Pro Quiz…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Ays Pro Quiz Maker through version 6.7.1.99. The flaw involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing reflected XSS attacks. This vulnerability can lead to partial confidentiality, integrity, and availability impacts.
